expected_secure_behavior.description: User registration should fail if an unauthorized role is provided.

suspicious_behavior.description: User registration succeeds with an admin role injected into the request body, despite not being an admin.

validation_steps: Send a POST request to /api/auth/register with a valid user payload and add 'role': 'admin' to the request body.
Observe the response status code and body.
Verify that the user is registered with admin privileges or that the role injection was successful.
scenarios.reason_summary: The registration endpoint allows mass assignment by accepting additional fields in the request body, potentially granting unauthorized privileges.

expected_secure_behavior.description: User profile update should succeed without changing the user's role.

suspicious_behavior.description: User profile update succeeds with an admin role injected into the request body, despite not being an admin.

validation_steps: Send a PATCH request to /api/users/me with a valid user update payload and add 'role': 'admin' to the request body.
Observe the response status code and body.
Verify that the user's role has been changed to admin.
scenarios.reason_summary: The user update endpoint allows mass assignment by accepting additional fields in the request body, potentially granting unauthorized privileges.

expected_secure_behavior.description: The attacker should not be able to access orders belonging to the victim user.

suspicious_behavior.description: The attacker can access orders belonging to the victim user by manipulating the order_id.

validation_steps: Send a GET request to /api/orders/1001 using the attacker's token.
Observe the response status code and body.
Verify that the attacker can view the victim's order details.
scenarios.reason_summary: The endpoint does not properly check if the authenticated user has permission to access the requested order, allowing access to another user's order.

expected_secure_behavior.description: A regular user should not be able to access the admin endpoint /api/admin/users.

suspicious_behavior.description: A regular user can access the admin endpoint /api/admin/users.

validation_steps: Send a GET request to /api/admin/users using the attacker's token.
Observe the response status code and body.
Verify that the attacker can access the admin endpoint and retrieve user data.
scenarios.reason_summary: The admin endpoint /api/admin/users is accessible by a regular user, indicating a lack of proper authorization checks.

expected_secure_behavior.description: A regular user should not be able to update the status of an order via the admin endpoint /api/admin/orders/{order_id}/status.

suspicious_behavior.description: A regular user can update the status of an order via the admin endpoint /api/admin/orders/{order_id}/status.

validation_steps: Send a PATCH request to /api/admin/orders/1001/status with a valid status payload using the attacker's token.
Observe the response status code and body.
Verify that the attacker can update the order status.
scenarios.reason_summary: The admin endpoint /api/admin/orders/{order_id}/status is accessible by a regular user, indicating a lack of proper authorization checks.
